metaDescription: Free online Word Counter. Count words and characters.
intro: Use our free online Word Counter tool. It counts words and characters based on your inputs.
whatIs: The Word Counter is an online utility that counts words and characters. It processes your text block and provides totals for words, characters, and paragraphs.
howToUse: Enter your text block into the designated input field.
Provide any secondary parameters like count metrics.
Click the calculate or submit button to generate totals for words, characters, and paragraphs.
Copy or review the resulting output for your needs.
howItWorks: This tool operates in your browser by applying standard algorithms to your text block. It instantly processes the data to output totals for words, characters, and paragraphs.
resultInterpretation: The result represents totals for words, characters, and paragraphs. You can use this data for your specific calculations or formatting needs.
useCases: Quickly processing text block on the go
tipsAndLimitations: Hyphenated words are usually counted as a single word.
Ensure your inputs are formatted correctly for the best results.
The tool runs completely client-side, ensuring your data remains private.

faq.question: Does it count spaces?
faq.answer: It provides both 'characters with spaces' and 'without spaces'.

faq.question: Is the Word Counter free to use?
faq.answer: Yes, our Word Counter is completely free and requires no registration.

faq.question: Does this work on mobile devices?
faq.answer: Yes, the tool is fully responsive and functions perfectly on all smartphones and tablets.
